blocks.title: Integration testing
blocks.text: After unit testing, integration testing checks the interaction between components or modules. While unit testing looks at isolated units, integration testing makes sure the units work together correctly when combined.
It checks for interface errors, data flow between modules and other integration problems, finding faults that unit testing cannot reveal, such as mismatches in how modules communicate or handle data.
